headline: Identity, control and operating status are answered; the file turns on two things the record cannot settle — the size of the open liens, and whether a UBO determination is required at all.

body.text: Two things are open against the policy: the unsized liens in Compliance, and the beneficial-ownership determination in Ownership that this record cannot produce at any price. The steps below close the file — the first is an order, the second a decision about what the policy will accept, and nothing else is blocking.

followUps.text: Order the lien and litigation detail — amounts, dates, and whether satisfied.
Settle whether the policy's beneficial-ownership requirement can be waived; no order will answer it.
Treat identity as closed and route the review on the liens alone.
If good standing is gating, ask the customer for the certificate — Delaware publishes no sub-status.
Re-run the registration search to clear the filings that returned no status, if your risk tier needs it.
